language.howToChooseYourGradeIntro: Our curriculum Grades K to 6 corresponds with ages:
language.howToChooseYourGradeContent:
It’s very important children start at the right level, have fun in learning and work at their own pace. Please help the children selecting the level that is not too easy, but also not too difficult for them. There are two ways to do this.

  • You can either check the learning goals yourself to determine the correct level for your child(ren).
  • Or you can let the child take several lessons to determine his or her level. For example, if your child has the age of 6, please let him or her take one lesson in grade K, one lesson in grade 1, and one lesson in grade 2 to determine at which level he or she is.

dialog.text: Hello, my name is Chip!
Good Day, I’m Abby! I’m on holiday with my family, and we have just stopped at the truck stop.
This is such a fun place. I love watching the trucks, and getting great food and toys from the shop.
You can see so many different shapes here! Let’s look at some.
The shape of this beach ball is called a SPHERE!
It has no corners, no edges and only one big face all around!
This shape is a CUBE. It has 6 faces, and lots of edges and corners! Try to count them.
This is a CYLINDER. It has a face at each end, and 1 big one all round, it has 2 edges but no corner.
A CONE is just like an ice cream cone! It has one round bottom, called the base, and it goes up to a point at the top. There's one edge at the bottom and one big, curved side that wraps around!
Now let’s go discover these shapes around us!
